_about: Overrides for the 35 seats (name, role, does, tools, brief, model, effort, boundaries). Empty by default: every seat shows the name and role from backend/app/seed/roster_seed.json, which is also what src/data.js draws. id, department and lead are fixed. Personal edits go in office.agents.local.json (gitignored). Agent personas are set up on the owner's machine after the platform boots; see PLAN.md section 11.
